  "description": "A value that can be either a literal or an expression.

This allows Function definitions to mix static values with dynamic
expressions. During compilation, expressions are evaluated while
literal values pass through unchanged.

# Example

Literal value:
```json
"hello world"
```

JMESPath expression:
```json
{"$jmespath": "input.greeting"}
```

Starlark expression:
```json
{"$starlark": "input['greeting']"}
```",

    {
      "description": "An expression (JMESPath or Starlark) to evaluate.",
      "$ref": "functions.expression.Expression"
    },
    {
      "description": "A literal value.",
      "$ref": "agent.completions.message.InputAudio"
    }
  ]
}
